name: Review Card
summary: Individual review content with supplied author metadata, Star Rating composition, and optional photos, action, and reply regions.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Semantic article containing one supplied review record.

anatomy.name: avatar
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned reviewer image or identity media.

anatomy.name: author
anatomy.description: Visible target-supplied reviewer name or attribution.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Optional visible target-formatted review date, preferably rendered with a semantic time element.

anatomy.name: verified
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned verification statement with readable text.

anatomy.name: rating
anatomy.description: Composed read-only Star Rating for the supplied review value.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional review heading within the surrounding document hierarchy.

anatomy.name: photos
anatomy.description: Optional horizontally contained collection of target-owned review photos.

anatomy.name: photo
anatomy.description: Repeated passive image or native link/button when the target supplies an action.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional action and related status region.

anatomy.name: helpfulButton
anatomy.description: Optional native toggle button that requests a helpfulness preference change.

anatomy.name: reply
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned reply semantically associated with this review.

properties.name: author
properties.description: Visible reviewer attribution supplied by the target.

properties.name: verifiedStatus
properties.description: Optional readable verification statement whose truth and vocabulary are owned by the review source.

properties.name: rating
properties.description: Required Star Rating composition for the target-supplied review value.

properties.name: body
properties.description: Review body text supplied by the target.

properties.name: photos
properties.description: Optional ordered review-photo collection; activation behavior is not implied.

properties.name: helpfulLabel
properties.description: Visible label for the optional helpfulness toggle button.

properties.name: helpfulPressed
properties.description: Current local pressed state of the optional helpfulness toggle; persistence is target-owned.

properties.name: helpfulDisabled
properties.description: Makes the optional native helpfulness action unavailable.

properties.name: helpfulCount
properties.description: Optional target-formatted helpfulness count; the component does not calculate or synchronize it.

properties.name: reply
properties.description: Optional target-owned reply content associated with the review.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive review card spacing and contained optional media.

states.name: photoHover
states.description: Fine-pointer feedback for a target-supplied native photo action.

states.name: actionFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the optional helpfulness button.

behavior.name: ratingComposition
behavior.description: Review Card composes Star Rating for read-only rating presentation and does not reuse Star Input.

behavior.name: helpfulnessRequest
behavior.description: The optional native button emits an activation request and exposes local pressed state; authentication, persistence, optimistic updates, and count synchronization remain target-owned.

behavior.name: photoActivationBoundary
behavior.description: Photos are passive by default. A target may use native link or button markup, but Review Card does not select or implement lightbox behavior.

accessibility: Render one review as a semantic article with author, date, rating, title, and body in logical source order.
Verification status needs readable text and must reflect target data rather than visual inference.
Give review images meaningful alt text, or empty alt text when they are genuinely decorative.
Use native buttons or links for target-supplied photo actions and preserve visible focus.
Expose helpfulness selection with aria-pressed on a native button; do not announce unsynchronized counts as confirmed updates.

web.notes: Responsive content, optional native action states, touch targets, focus, forced colors, and reduced motion are implemented in components/css/reviews.css.

shopify.notes: A future adapter must choose review data and action providers without changing the neutral content contract.
